context_pill: Section 4 & 28: Diversion vs Application of Income

beats.voice_sync_text: Nammude assessee Mr. Bhargava, Supreme Court-il oru company-kku vendi appear cheyyan ₹ 5,00,000 fee negotiate cheythu. Pakshe condition: ee amount ayal create cheyyunna oru public charitable trust-ilekku povanam. Section 4 charging principles prakaram ithu Diversion of Income aano atho mere Application of Income aano?

quote_box.statute: Section 4 vs Section 28(i) of Income-tax Act, 1961
quote_box.text: Whether professional fees received subject to a self-imposed obligation to transfer the funds to a charitable trust constitutes Diversion by Overriding Title or taxable Application of Professional Income?
quote_box.highlight: Diversion by Overriding Title or taxable Application of Professional Income

beats.voice_sync_text: Ivide legal characterization check cheyyan Income Tax-il randu paths und. Superior legal title vazhi income assessee-kku kittunnathinu mumbey divert aayal ath Diversion of Income aanu, non-taxable. Ennal income assess-kku reach cheytha sesham, assessee-yude voluntary act vazhi mathram transfer cheythal ath Application of Income aayi maarum.

Landmark precedent Supreme Court-inte CIT v. Sitaldas Tirathdas aanu. Ee judgment-il Supreme Court theerth paranju: Income source-il ninnum assessee-yude adukkal ethunnathinu mumbey legal title vazhi divert cheythal mathrame exclusion kittu. Bhargava-yude case-il, client alla trust create cheythathu, client-inu obligation onnum illayirunnu. Obligation create cheythathu Mr. Bhargava thanneyanu.

ratio_box.verdict: Does the amount reach the assessee first as his own income and then applied? If yes, it is an Application of Income. A self-imposed obligation by the recipient does NOT create an overriding title.

beats.voice_sync_text: Ini namukk Mr. Bhargava-yude Assessment Year computation nokkam. Company nalkiya ₹ 5,00,000 ayalude Professional Receipts aanu. Ayal trust execute cheythu transfer cheythathu mere post-receipt application mathramayanu. So full ₹ 5,00,000 PGBP head-il assessable aakum.

ledger_rows.desc: Less: Claim of Diversion by Overriding Title

beats.voice_sync_text: CA Final exam point of view-il ee 3 Golden Rules eppozhum orkuka. Rule 1: Source of obligation check cheyyuka. Rule 2: Stage of interception examine cheyyuka. Rule 3: Self-imposed trusts are always Application of Income, taxable under PGBP.

rules.exp: Overriding title exists only if an external superior law, court decree, or payer creates the obligation before income reaches the assessee.
Diversion occurs at the source (interception). Applying funds after earning title or receipt is mere destination (application).
A professional directing clients to pay fees into their own trust is fully taxable under Section 28 as PGBP; Chapter VI-A (Section 80G) can only be explored separately.
